## 3. Authoritative Specifications & Invariant Compliance

- **BigInt Amount Precision**: User balances and economy transactions maintain full integer precision without 32-bit bitwise truncation.
- **Discord Constraints**: Snowflake validation rejects non-digit/malformed strings; string lengths respect 2000-character Discord message bounds and 256/4096-character embed limits.
- **Transactional Atomicity**: Store purchases and payroll payouts execute inside PostgreSQL transactions with row-level locks (`FOR UPDATE`), preventing race conditions and partial writes.
- **Cache Invalidation & Real-Time Sync**: Database mutations synchronize immediately to bot repository `TTLCache` instances.
- **Zero Mock Data**: All tests execute against real PostgreSQL schemas and live Discord bot entities.
